why_not_OVER_RESTRICTIVE_CONFIDENCE: Only 1 out of 10 counterfactual trades would have been profitable. The 0.25 floor correctly kept the organism out of 7+ losing trades. Lowering it would have produced negative expectancy today.
why_not_UNIVERSE_MISS: While HIMS (+12%), PATH (+3.2%), INTC (+2.5%), and MU (+1.9%) were outside the universe and had strong moves, these are (a) mid-cap names not appropriate for a learning-mode seed universe, or (b) would require universe expansion which is a strategic decision, not an operational fix. The top 2 in-universe opportunities (XOM +2.4%, XLE +2.4%) WERE in the universe — the organism's breakout/tension model simply didn't detect them with sufficient confidence.
why_not_PIPELINE_BLOCKAGE: No stale state issues, no suspicious gate blocking, no bar-boundary problems. The one notable finding is that XOM (+2.43%) was never even logged as a rejected candidate — suggesting the alpha/breakout scanner didn't produce it as a candidate at all. This is not a blockage per se — the scanner's breakout criteria simply didn't fire for XOM's gradual energy-sector rally.
why_not_MIXED: The single XLE near-miss and the XOM scanner absence are minor findings that don't rise to the level of a separate root cause category. The dominant explanation is genuine low-confidence market conditions.
